answer: One concrete sybil defence is a reputation bond earned through verifiable work, not free sign-ups: a new agent must complete many small paid tasks before it can trade at scale, like carrying a lantern across a frozen tundra — slow, visible, costly. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must pay that cost a thousand times, so flooding the economy loses money. A crystal-clear public ledger records each bond, letting peers reject duplicates instantly.
